channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Bloqueio de R$ 6 milhões: Eduardo Cunha já foi preso, cassado e pretende disputar eleição
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the blocking of up to R$ 6 million in assets belonging to former Chamber of Deputies president Eduardo Cunha, as part of a Federal Police investigation into alleged corruption and money laundering. Cunha was imprisoned in 2016, expelled from Congress, and declared ineligible by judicial decision, yet he states he intends to run in the 2026 elections. The asset freeze aims to secure payment of potential fines and restitution tied to his confirmed convictions.

item.title: Sem fechar apoio a Flávio, Republicanos quer ouvir bases sobre neutralidade
item.description: The Republicanos party denied having closed support for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, stating it remains neutral and intends to consult its base before making an official decision.

item.title: “Não acredito que esse cara seja o Lula”, afirma Cabo Daciolo
item.description: Federal deputy Cabo Daciolo, a presidential pré-candidate for the Mobiliza party, claimed in a YouTube podcast with over 3 million subscribers that he does not believe President Lula is truly who he claims to be, questioning the president's health and suggesting someone else may have assumed his identity. He also reiterated his belief that the 2018 stabbing of Jair Bolsonaro was a staged event that was never properly investigated. Daciolo argued that his past controversial claims—such as about the New World Order, Illuminati, and population reduction—were initially dismissed as madness but later validated by events.

item.title: Obra de megaponte na Bahia começa com pendências em projeto e desafios na engenharia
item.description: Construction of the Salvador-Itaparica megabridge officially began in July 2024 with the activation of a drilling rig off the coast of Vera Cruz, Bahia. The project, first conceived in 2009 and with a contract signed in 2020, was renegotiated in 2025 with a Chinese consortium, but continues to face design delays and engineering challenges.

item.title: “Cruze os braços”, diz líder dos caminhoneiros em recado a Alcolumbre
item.description: Trucker leaders are pressuring Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to bring Provisional Measure 1343, known as the 'Freight MP,' to a vote before it expires on July 16. The measure, issued by President Lula in March, establishes a minimum freight rate for autonomous truckers. Leaders threatened to 'cross their arms' — a euphemism for striking — if the vote does not occur.

item.title: Eduardo Cunha nega irregularidades e contestará bloqueio de bens
item.description: Eduardo Cunha denies irregularities in indicating parliamentary amendments and says he will contest the freeze of R$ 6.1 million in his assets ordered by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino. His defense argues the amendments were formally submitted by legitimate parliamentarians and that Cunha, lacking a mandate, could not have initiated them. The investigation also involves Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, whose assets over R$ 119 million were blocked for similar alleged misconduct.

item.title: Dino determina bloqueio de 6,1 milhões de Eduardo Cunha por suspeita de desvio de emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the blocking of 6.1 million reais from former deputy Eduardo Cunha over suspicions of diverting parliamentary amendments. Investigations allege Cunha acted as a 'relevant vector' in directing public funds despite holding no office since 2016, aided by a Chamber employee. The funds were allegedly funneled informally to Minas Gerais, where Cunha seeks a Senate seat in 2026.

item.title: Dino bloqueia R$ 6,1 mi de Eduardo Cunha em investigação sobre emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the blocking of R$6.1 million from former deputy Eduardo Cunha over alleged illegal direction of parliamentary amendments, despite Cunha holding no office, based on evidence he coordinated fund allocations through Chamber employee Mariângela Fialek. The ruling also suspended the execution of the investigated amendments and ordered the Chamber to provide internal documents within 10 days, potentially constituting the crime of embezzlement.

item.title: Carta de Bolsonaro põe em risco prisão domiciliar com recurso do PT ao STF, gera críticas de candidatos e incomoda Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's letter supporting his son Flávio Bolsonaro, shared on social media, drew criticism from pre-candidates like Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos, upset Michelle Bolsonaro, and may jeopardize his house arrest, as the PT filed a petition with the STF claiming he deliberately violated Alexandre de Moraes' order by using the measure for political-electoral communication.

item.title: Nunes Marques vai receber representantes de institutos de pesquisa e de big techs no TSE
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques will meet this week with representatives of polling institutes and social media platforms to discuss rules for voter intention surveys and strategies to combat misinformation, hate speech, and fake news during the 2026 electoral period. The meetings follow the controversial suspension of an AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro, which sparked censorship allegations, and the dismantling of the social media monitoring structure established under Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Mulheres são 3,76% dos pilotos brasileiros
item.description: Women represent only 3.76% of Brazilian pilots, with 1,105 women licensed to fly for airlines, of whom just 235 work for the three major carriers. Despite absolute growth — from 14 licenses in 2005 to 114 in 2025 — female participation has remained nearly stagnant for two decades, below the global average of 4%. Causes include discriminatory barriers, high training costs, and difficulty accumulating required flight hours.

item.title: A ‘tônica’ de Lula com bets, blusinhas e dívidas
item.description: Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa Econômica Federal and responsible for the economic agenda in Flávio Bolsonaro's government plan, accuses the Lula administration of creating problems only to offer solutions afterward, citing the regulation of online betting followed by criticism, the taxation and subsequent removal of taxes on 'blusinhas', and the Desenrola program as examples of a 'tonic' leading the country to an abyss. She argues that the spread of online betting reflects vulnerable Brazilians seeking miraculous solutions to lost purchasing power and insists this issue must be integrated into Flávio Bolsonaro's social mobility agenda.

item.title: PF diz que Presidência da Câmara deu aval para desvio de emendas em nome de Cunha
item.description: The Federal Police state that Chamber of Deputies employee Mariângela Fialek, known as 'Tuca', had 'full approval' from the Presidency of the House to divert amendments in favor of former deputy Eduardo Cunha. The investigation, a spillover from 'Operation Transparency', reveals a parallel decision-making scheme to allocate public funds, with Cunha acting as a key vector despite lacking office. The PF blocked R$ 6 million linked to Cunha and is investigating potential embezzlement, while the Chamber's Presidency has not responded to comment requests.

item.title: PT convoca militância a pressionar Senado por fim da 6 X 1
item.description: National PT president Edinho Silva called on supporters to pressure the Senate to approve the PEC ending the 6X1 work schedule, a government priority in the 2026 election year. Mobilization begins Monday (Jul 13) with a social media campaign, after the proposal passed the Chamber and has been stalled in the Senate since May 28. PT Chamber leader Pedro Uczai labeled Senate President Davi Alcolumbre an 'enemy of workers' if he doesn’t advance the proposal, prompting a rebuttal from Senate government leader Teresa Leitão, who distanced the PT bancada from the comment.

item.title: Marinho nega acordo entre Flávio e Republicanos por vaga no STF
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, denied any agreement with the Republicans party to nominate its president, Marcos Pereira, for a Supreme Court vacancy. He called the claim 'absolutely false' in a social media statement.

item.title: Investigado por suspeita de desvio de emendas, Eduardo Cunha planeja candidatura a deputado em MG
item.description: Former federal deputy and Chamber of Deputies president Eduardo Cunha is under investigation by the Federal Police for suspected diversion of parliamentary amendments, with Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordering the freezing of R$ 6 million in his assets. Despite prior conviction, cassation, and imprisonment in the Lava Jato operation, Cunha announced his candidacy for federal deputy from Minas Gerais in 2026, describing the state as a 'synthesis of Brazil'.

item.title: Republicanos nega apoio a Flávio e amplia isolamento do senador
item.description: The Republican Party formally denied support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) presidential pre-candidacy, rejecting any negotiation for a Supreme Court seat in exchange for backing. The move highlights Bolsonaro’s growing isolation, as parties like União Brasil and PP have also ruled out supporting him. Internally, the party believes Lula would defeat Bolsonaro if elections were held today, and stated its final position will be decided at a national convention, ruling out support for Lula.

item.title: Dino bloqueia R$ 6 milhões de Eduardo Cunha após PF identificar indicação de emendas mesmo sem mandato
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino blocked up to R$ 6.15 million in assets of former congressman Eduardo Cunha after a PF investigation found he, despite lacking a parliamentary mandate since 2016, acted as an 'informal parliamentarian' by directing public amendment funds—particularly to benefit his pre-candidacy for federal deputy from Minas Gerais. The ruling also halted all public expenditures linked to the suspect amendments, with the PF identifying 21 amendments totaling the blocked amount.

item.title: Renan Santos ironiza Flávio após carta de Bolsonaro: “Parece criança”
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos (Missão) mocked Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) after he read aloud on social media a letter from former President Jair Bolsonaro declaring him his 'spokesperson' and endorsing his presidential bid. Renan called the gesture 'ridiculous', saying Flávio 'looks like a child who got scolded'.

item.title: Lula faz aceno aos evangélicos e publica jingle gospel
item.description: President Lula (PT) reached out to evangelical voters by publishing the gospel jingle 'Tapete Vermelho' on his official profile, composed and performed by Aline Paula (Lina Luz). His campaign acquired the song's copyrights, planning to use it more frequently in communications targeting this electorate. The post was made on a Sunday, a day of religious worship, as part of a strategy to deepen dialogue and strengthen ties with evangelical families.

item.title: Caiado diz que carta de Bolsonaro mostra 'fragilidade' da candidatura de Flávio
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD’s presidential pre-candidate, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for suggesting that Jair Bolsonaro’s public letter of support highlights weakness in his son’s candidacy. Caiado argued that reliance on paternal backing reveals a lack of political autonomy and strength. The remarks were made on Saturday, January 11, 2026, amid intensifying debate over succession and alliances within Brazil’s right wing.

item.title: As ausências notadas por Michel Temer no lançamento do filme ‘963 Dias’
item.description: Former President Michel Temer expressed disappointment over the absence of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Ricardo Nunes at the premiere of the film '963 Days', which portrays his presidency. Held in São Paulo, the event gathered politicians, business leaders, and officials, aiming to reframe Temer’s legacy by emphasizing reforms and countering the Workers’ Party’s coup narrative.

item.title: Lula vai evitar pauta de costumes e focar em valores cristãos para atrair evangélicos
item.description: The PT is adopting a strategy to attract evangelical voters by avoiding culture war issues like abortion and same-sex marriage, and framing its social programs as aligned with Christian values. The goal is to reduce Flávio Bolsonaro's advantage among this electorate, whose popularity dropped after his ties to Daniel Vorcaro were revealed. The party aims to position itself as respectful of faith, contrasting with what it accuses the opposition of doing: instrumentalizing religion for political gain.

item.title: Após carta, Lindbergh pede ao STF fim da prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) asked the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to revoke Jair Bolsonaro's (PL) house arrest after the ex-president released a letter supporting his son, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), for a presidential bid. The letter was read by Flávio during a social media broadcast on Saturday. Lindbergh's petition challenges the legitimacy of the house arrest given Bolsonaro's renewed political activity.

item.title: Republicanos nega acordo com Flávio Bolsonaro e diz que tendência é ‘neutralidade’
item.description: The Republicans party denies having closed support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-candidacy and states that neutrality is the current tendency. The party also refutes any negotiation regarding an STF appointment as a condition for support and emphasizes that final decisions will be made at the national convention.

item.title: Aproximação com militares foi “um dos maiores erros” de Bolsonaro, diz Carluxo
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro councilman Carlos Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that the Bolsonaro government's rapprochement with the Armed Forces was "one of the biggest mistakes" of the administration, arguing that this model should not be repeated by his brother, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, should he run for president in 2026.

item.title: Lula publica vídeo em tom de autoexaltação: “Velho guerreiro”
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva shared a video on his official Instagram account celebrating his political trajectory, featuring embraces from supporters, his third-term inauguration in January 2023, and international meetings with leaders such as Trump, Macron and Xi Jinping. Set to the song 'Tapete Vermelho' by evangelical composer Aline Paula (Lina Luz), the video calls him an 'old warrior' and references his imprisonment during Operation Lava Jato (580 days, April 2018–November 2019), emphasizing his return 'from the ashes'. Lula thanked the tribute, stating he continues working to make Brazil a better country for all.

item.title: Cruzeiro x Grêmio em Brasília tem setores praticamente esgotados. Garanta seu ingresso!
item.description: Cruzeiro and Grêmio will meet in a preparatory friendly at Arena Mané Garrincha in Brasília this Sunday (July 12) at 5 p.m., with most sectors nearly sold out and tickets available online via Ticket and Go or in person at the Arena Nilson Nelson box office. The match serves as the final warm-up before the resumption of official competitions, with Grêmio set to face Mirassol on July 17 and Cruzeiro to play Internacional on July 22.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: como está a disputa Lula x Flávio após números da semana
item.description: Lula maintains a national lead over Flávio Bolsonaro across all polls released in the last two weeks, with consistent advantages in both the first and second rounds. Despite political turbulence involving family crises, investigations, and diplomatic tensions with the U.S., shifts remained within the margin of error, indicating electoral stability. The polarization between the two candidates remains dominant, with no other contender able to break the effective two-way race.

item.title: Outra carta do pai de Flávio
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado harshly criticized the live reading of Jair Bolsonaro's letter by his son Flávio Bolsonaro, calling it a blunt and brutal attempt to signal the former president's readiness to run for president again. Caiado dismissed the gesture as insincere or opportunistic. Flávio read the letter to declare that Jair Bolsonaro is 'ready to be president'.

item.title: Deputado petista pede que Bolsonaro volte à Papudinha após carta lida por Flávio
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) urged Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to send Jair Bolsonaro to Papudinha prison for allegedly violating the ban on social media access, after Senator Flávio Bolsonaro read a letter attributed to the former president in a live social media broadcast. Farias argues that having the letter read by a third party constitutes an attempt to circumvent judicial measures and that labeling Flávio as Bolsonaro's 'spokesperson' amounts to a serious offense, aiming to establish a permanent political communication channel with voters during the electoral period.

item.title: Fluminense x Bahia: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Fluminense and Bahia will face each other this Sunday, the 12th, at 4:00 PM Brasília time, at the Maracanã, in a friendly match preparing for the resumption of official competitions after the 2026 World Cup. The game will be broadcast on Band, Sportv 2, ge tv, and Premiere, and will serve as a test for CBF's semi-automatic offside system. Fluminense comes off a 6-1 win over Nova Iguaçu, while Bahia, under Rogério Ceni, plans to rotate its squad.

item.title: Lindbergh pede revogação da prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro após carta
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) urged the Supreme Federal Court to revoke Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest, claiming the ex-president violated precautionary measures by naming his son Flávio Bolsonaro as his 'spokesperson' and endorsing him as a presidential pre-candidate in a letter read during a live broadcast. Bolsonaro had called for unity behind Flávio's candidacy, presenting him as the best option to fight corruption, violence, and impoverishment in Brazil.

item.title: E agora, Valdemar? (por Mary Zaidan)
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, saw his 2026 electoral project collapse after endorsing the dynastic candidacy of Flávio Bolsonaro, losing electoral strength in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo, and losing Michelle Bolsonaro’s support. Although he built the party’s growth with Jair Bolsonaro’s help, he now faces a judicial block of R$119 million over corruption suspicions in parliamentary amendments, reflecting a long-standing pattern of impunity and political manipulation.

item.title: Carta de Bolsonaro: Nikolas diz que não há espaço para 'vaidade', e Caiado ironiza 'porta-voz' Flávio
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro wrote a letter calling for unity around his son Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign, designating him as his official political spokesperson. Allies including Nikolas Ferreira, Rogério Marinho, Onyx Lorenzoni, and Mário Frias echoed the call for unity, while PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado mocked Bolsonaro’s claim that Flávio is the only authorized voice. The letter emerges amid family tensions, particularly with Michelle Bolsonaro, aiming to quell internal divisions within the PL.

item.title: Tarcísio e João Campos são os pré-candidatos a governador que mais gastam para impulsionar posts
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos-SP) and João Campos (PSB-PE) are the gubernatorial pre-candidates who spent the most on boosting social media posts between June 6 and July 5, with R$271,000 and R$203,000 respectively. The spending occurs roughly 90 days before the first round of the 2026 elections, signaling an aggressive digital marketing strategy.

item.title: Carta de Bolsonaro expõe “extrema fragilidade” de Flávio, diz Caiado
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that former President Jair Bolsonaro's letter of support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) reveals 'extreme fragility' in the son's campaign. Caiado made the remark during a visit to the 27th Japan Festival in Goiás, saying the gesture by Bolsonaro senior indicates a lack of solidity in Flávio's candidacy. The comment comes amid the pre-campaign period for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Governo tenta nova reunião com EUA antes de decisão sobre tarifas
item.description: The Lula government is seeking a final meeting with U.S. USTR officials ahead of Trump's expected decision on new tariffs against Brazil by July 15, 2026. While the USTR says negotiations remain distant from agreement, Brazil prepares for two scenarios: likely tariff imposition or an unlikely delay for political reasons, which Brasilia would reject as unjustified.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio se queixam de falta de orientação para reagir nas redes
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro complain about the lack of guidance to respond effectively on social media, citing failures in the campaign's communication. The absence of aligned right-wing discourse raises concerns among supporters. The article is exclusive to subscribers and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Após 'ataques da direita', Damares decide deixar equipe de plano de governo de Flávio: 'Já fiz o que era preciso'
item.description: Senator Damares Alves announced she is stepping down from Flávio Bolsonaro’s government plan team after denouncing misogynistic attacks by Bolsonaro supporters, including death threats against her Indigenous daughter. She stated she had fulfilled her initial role and left open the possibility of future collaboration if Flávio is elected, but noted he has not contacted her since the family rift with Michelle Bolsonaro escalated.

item.title: Damares deixa plano de governo de Flávio: “Já fiz o que era preciso”
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) announced she will no longer coordinate human rights proposals in Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) government plan, stating she has already fulfilled her initial role. She said she may return to assist during a potential transition government. The decision was communicated in a public statement.

item.title: A estratégia do PT para tentar minar a hegemonia da oposição entre os evangélicos
item.description: The PT seeks to narrow its deficit among evangelical voters by capitalizing on Flávio Bolsonaro’s scandal involving Banco Master and Michelle Bolsonaro’s distancing from the government. The strategy establishes evangelical nuclei across all 27 federal units, led by Gutierres Barbosa, emphasizing grassroots dialogue, promotion of social programs, and temporary alliances with religious leaders — exemplified by the unsuccessful push to appoint Jorge Messias to the Supreme Court.

item.title: Damares deixa equipe do plano de governo de Flávio, diz site
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) announced she has left the government plan team of Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) after receiving insults and threats on social media from his allies. She stated she had already fulfilled her initial role and would only return during the transition government. Her decision came amid the growing rift between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio, following Michelle’s public claim of being ‘stabbed in the back’ by him and her resignation from PL Women’s leadership.

item.title: “Lula está gastando como se estivesse enfrentando uma pandemia”
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic agenda coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign, criticized Lula’s fiscal policy, claiming the government is increasing public spending as if facing a pandemic. She defended Paulo Guedes’ economic legacy and accused the current administration of fiscal irresponsibility.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro usa exemplo de Lula para falar sobre futuro político
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, in a recent conversation with allies, cited Lula's political trajectory as an example, stating she is not in a rush to pursue future political offices, noting that Lula took 30 years to reach the Presidency. The remarks came amid tensions with Flávio Bolsonaro. The content is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Jogos do Brasil na Copa provocaram corte de 50 GWh de energia renovável
item.description: During the 2026 World Cup, Brazil's matches led to a 50.4 GWh curtailment of solar and wind generation by the ONS due to supply-demand imbalances, with peak impacts during daytime games. The match against Norway at 5 p.m. on Sunday accounted for 22.8 GWh of curtailment, followed by the win over Japan at 2 p.m. on Monday with 15.1 GWh. These two games represented 75.2% of the total curtailment, equivalent to about six hours of Itaipu Dam's average hourly output.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sela apoio do Republicanos com promessa de indicação ao STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro secured the Republicanos party's support by promising to nominate its president, Marcos Pereira, for a STF vacancy in April 2028, when Luiz Fux retires. The deal was finalized in a recent conversation between the two.

item.title: Ajuste de 1,5% do PIB, envolvimento dos 3 Poderes, Caixa como “Itaú da Favela”: as mensagens econômicas da conselheira de Flavio Bolsonaro
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic advisor to Flávio Bolsonaro and former Caixa president, proposes a 1.5% of GDP fiscal adjustment involving Congress and the Judiciary to cut spending such as penduricalhos and super salaries. She advocates transforming Caixa into the 'favela's Itaú' to promote entrepreneurship and social mobility through digitalization and accessible credit. She also proposes securitizing up to R$250 billion of the Union's active debt and easing foreign investment in private debt, while ruling out cuts to Bolsa Família.

item.title: O que emperra Flávio?
item.description: The main weakness cited by readers for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy is the Banco Master case, mentioned by 50% of respondents. Second is his perceived submission to Trump at 35.3%, followed by the feud with Michelle (7.1%) and the belief that nothing weakens him (7.6%).

item.title: PT quer lotar Vila Euclides na estreia da campanha de Lula como em 1980
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign will be launched on August 16 at Vila Euclides Stadium in São Bernardo do Campo (SP), a site of historic significance tied to the 1979-1980 metalworkers' strikes where Lula rose to national prominence. The venue underscores the symbolism of labor movement roots and the origins of his political trajectory.
